meta.title: Gwada Pain001 a Burauzarku
meta.description: Ɗora ko liƙa bayanan biyan kuɗi na CSV ku ga tantancewa a aikace: IBAN mod-97, tsarin BIC, filayen dole, jimillolin sarrafawa da XSD na hukuma. Duk a burauzarku.

text.Drop in a CSV, use the sample, or paste: Saka fayil ɗin CSV, yi amfani da samfurin, ko liƙa bayanan naku. Tantancewa na gudana nan take, gaba ɗaya a cikin burauzarku, kuma babu abin da zai taɓa barin na'urarku.
text.How this validator helps you: Yadda wannan kayan tantancewa ke taimaka muku
text.<span class=\"tick\" aria-hidden=\"true\: ✓Gwada bayanan biyan kuɗi bisa gwaje-gwajen da bankuna ke amfani da su: filayen dole, lambobin tantance IBAN, tsarin BIC, jimillolin sarrafawa
✓Samar da ingantaccen fayil ɗin pain.001.001.09 canja wurin kuɗi wanda za ku iya bincika, kwafa, ko saukewa
✓Tabbatar da sakamakon bisa tsarin ISO 20022 na hukuma, ta amfani da XSD na asali wanda ake tantancewa a cikin burauzarku
text.<strong>Nothing is uploaded.</strong> Yo: Ba a ɗora komai. Burauzarku ce ke karanta fayil ɗinku kuma ba ya taɓa barin na'urarku. Babu sabar, babu ajiya, babu aiko da bayanai. Yana da aminci ga bayanai na gaske, amma amfani da bayanan gwaji da aka ɓoye shi ne al'ada mafi kyau.
text.<strong>Testing tool only.</strong> File: Kayan gwaji ne kawai. Ba a taɓa mika fayiloli don sarrafawa ba, kuma babu wani biyan kuɗi da zai iya faruwa sakamakon duk abin da kuka yi a nan.
text.<strong>Expected columns:</strong> <code: Ginshiƙan da ake tsammani: payment_id, payment_amount, currency, sunan mai biya da mai karɓa / IBAN / BIC, requested_execution_date. Ana gane alamomin rabewa na waƙafi, waƙafi-da-ɗigo, da tab kai tsaye. Ku sauke samfuri a ƙasa don amfani da shi a matsayin abin koyi ga fitar da bayanan naku.
text.<strong>No charges.</strong> This tool,: Babu wani caji. Wannan kayan aiki, da cikakken jerin kayan aiki da ke bayansa, kyauta ne kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe.
text.\"Nothing is uploaded\" is a claim you c: "Ba a ɗora komai" magana ce da za ku iya gwada gaskiyarta cikin mintuna biyu:
text.Open DevTools&nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp;Network,: Buɗe DevTools → Network, sannan ku yi amfani da nunin. Buƙatun da ke akwai kawai su ne GET na asali ɗaya (same-origin) don kayan wannan shafi, injin WASM, da tsarin (schema). Babu ɗayansu da ke ɗauke da bayanan ku.
text.Run the XSD gate once, then switch DevTo: Gudanar da ƙofar XSD sau ɗaya, sannan ku mayar da DevTools zuwa Offline (ko kashe Wi-Fi). Dukan nunin, har da ƙofar tsarin hukuma, na ci gaba da aiki: wani service worker na adana komai bayan amfani na farko.
text.<a href=\"https://github.com/sebastienro: Wannan shafi ma buɗaɗɗen tushe ne: dabarar nunin modul ɗaya ne marar dogaro da wani abu, wanda za ku iya karantawa gaba ɗaya.
text.There is no analytics script, no error-r: Babu rubutun bin diddigi (analytics), babu sabis na rahoton kuskure, babu rubutun haruffa na wani ɓangare na uku, kuma babu wurin aika rahoton CSP, domin aika rahoto shi kansa haɗi ne zuwa waje.
text.<strong>Drag a CSV file here</strong> or: Ja fayil ɗin CSV zuwa nan ko danna don bincika
text.Maximum 2&nbsp;MB · read locally by your: Iyaka 2 MB · burauzarku na karanta shi a na'urarku, ba a taɓa ɗorawa
text.Download a sample to use as your own tem: Ku sauki samfuri don amfani da shi a matsayin abin koyi naku: canja wurin kuɗi na SEPA · na ƙetare · rukunin layi 20
text.Validation result &amp; generated XML: Sakamakon tantancewa & XML da aka samar
text.Add data in step 1 and validation runs a: Ƙara bayanai a mataki na 1, tantancewa za ta gudana kai tsaye.
text.Data quality <span class=\"layer-hint\">: Ingancin bayanai (fiye da abin da schema ke dubawa)
text.Not run: choose a scheme rulebook in ste: Ba a gudanar ba: zaɓi littafin ƙa'idar tsari a mataki na 1
text.Not evaluated: Pain001 ships no bank pro: Ba a auna ba: Pain001 ba ya zuwa da bayanan tsarin kowane banki
text.Not evaluated: decided by your bank, not: Ba a auna ba: bankinku ne ke yanke shawara, ba fayil ɗin ba
text.Validation findings by row and column: Sakamakon tantancewa bisa layi da ginshiƙi
text.Prove it against the official ISO 20022: Tabbatar da shi bisa XSD na ISO 20022 na hukuma
text.Steps 1–2 already ran the pain001 librar: Steps 1–2 already ran the pain001 library itself: its record validation, the scheme rulebook you chose, XML generation, and the official pain.001.001.09 schema gate on the result, all inside a Python runtime compiled to WebAssembly and served from this site. This button re-runs the schema gate on the XML shown above, so you can edit the document and check it again. The runtime (about 28 MB) downloads once, the first time you validate, and stays cached.
text.Generate XML in step 2 first. The XSD ga: Ku fara samar da XML a mataki na 2. Ƙofar XSD tana aiki ne a kan wannan fitarwa.
text.Everything on this page runs in your bro: Duk abin da ke wannan shafi yana gudana a cikin burauzarku. Ba a ɗora komai, ba a ajiye komai, kuma ba a aika komai ko'ina. Yana gudanar da ɗakin karatu na pain001 shi kansa, fakiti ɗaya da kuke shigarwa da pip, a cikin Python runtime da aka harhaɗa zuwa WebAssembly: tantance bayanai, binciken IBAN da BIC, littafin ƙa'idar tsari da kuka zaɓa, samar da XML tare da jimillolin sarrafawa na NbOfTxs/CtrlSum da aka sake lissafawa, da ƙofar XSD ta hukuma. Abin da CLI ke ƙarawa shi ne girma da nau'ikan shigarwa: fayiloli na kowane girma, Excel, SQLite, JSON, Parquet da SWIFT MT101, da kowace sigar saƙo. Ku shigar da CLI don cikakken jerin aikin.
text.What this demo shows, and what the real: Abin da wannan nunin ke nunawa, da abin da ainihin jerin aikin ke ƙarawa
text.Each sample batch is also <a href=\"/sam: Kowane samfurin rukuni kuma ana iya saukar da shi a matsayin fayil ɗin CSV don amfani da shi a matsayin abin koyi ga fitar da bayanai daga ERP ko maƙunsar bayanai naku. Layin kanun shi ne yarjejeniyar.
text.The demo above runs the pain001 library: Demo da ke sama tana gudanar da laburaren pain001 da kansa, ba kwaikwayonsa ba: binciken filayen da ake bukata, lissafin IBAN mod-97 bisa ISO 13616, tsarin BIC bisa ISO 9362, tsarin adadi da kwanan wata, jimillar sarrafawa (NbOfTxs, CtrlSum) da ake sake lissafawa daga bayanan maimakon a amince da su kawai, littafin dokokin tsarin da kuka zaba, da kofar XSD ta hukuma. Gwada menu na "Saka kuskure…": kowane yanayi na dasa kuskure guda ɗaya na gaske (lambar IBAN da aka juya, BIC mara kyau, ginshiƙin da ya ɓace, kuɗin da aka rubuta da waƙafin Turai, kwanan watan da ba zai yiwu ba) kuma ya nuna muku sakamakon layi-da-layi wanda ƙofar banki za ta ba da rahotonsa bayan kwanaki da dama.
text.The installed toolchain adds what a brow: Kayan aikin da aka shigar suna kara abin da shafin burauza ba zai iya ba: fayiloli na kowane girma; shigarwa daga Excel, SQLite, JSON, Parquet da SWIFT MT101; dukkan bayanan tsari 29, har da cire kudi kai tsaye da wajibcin lambobin manufa (demo tana bayar da 16), tare da fitarwar --explain doka bayan doka; da kowane bugu da ake tallafawa, nau'o'i goma sha daya na pain.001 da nau'i biyu na pain.008 (.02 da .08).
text.Step 3 re-runs the schema gate on its ow: Mataki na 3 yana sake gudanar da kofar tsari shi kadai, don ku iya gyara XML da ke sama ku sake duba shi: xmlschema kan tsarin pain.001.001.09 na hukuma, wanda wannan shafin ke bayarwa. Irin kofar XSD daya ce da CLI ke amfani da ita.
text.The validated pain.001.001.09 document w: Takardar pain.001.001.09 da aka tantance za ta bayyana a nan da zarar kun shigar da bayanai a mataki na 1.
